scope: Logical PUnit countermodel with an unconstrained solver predicate accepting constant-one work; this refutes the implication only and does not assert that a real subexponential ECDLP solver exists.
statement: The semantic rank-at-most-solution-count premise and an average solution-count upper bound of two do not, by themselves, establish the parameterized no-subexponential-ECDLP goal.
